items.title: Malicious PyPI Package Mimics as SOCKS5 Proxy Tool Attacking Windows Platforms
items.description: A sophisticated malicious package has infiltrated the Python Package Index (PyPI), masquerading as a legitimate SOCKS5 proxy tool while harboring backdoor capabilities that target Windows systems.
